verdict.rationale: Deel documents a public REST endpoint to create a contractor contract (POST /rest/contracts). It also offers an official MCP server that lets agents invoke Deel API operations over people, contracts and payroll data, with a sandbox for safe testing. So an agent can start onboarding a worker via the API. However, the evidence only shows contractor contract creation and generic data exposure, not an end-to-end flow covering employee records, compensation or tax setup. Missing for 10: documented employee (EOR or payroll) creation endpoints, compensation setup via API, tax or withholding setup via API, MCP tools that create hires, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent onboarding flow.
